summary: Zillow Group filed an 8-K reporting its 2026 Annual Meeting results and an amendment to its 2026 repurchase program. The board amended the program to bar share repurchases that would cause any single shareholder to own more than 45% of voting power; no current shareholder exceeds that threshold. The original program authorized up to $1.25 billion in repurchases of Class A common stock or Class C capital stock. All other terms remain unchanged. This is a share buyback program update, not a tender offer or going-private transaction. Watch for potential 13D filings by large holders or any stock price reaction to the ownership cap.
